heroTitle: Stop phishing before it stops you.
heroSub: PhishGuard AI inspects any link for impersonation, look-alike domains and scam patterns in milliseconds.
disclaimer: No tool can guarantee a link is 100% safe. We never open scanned URLs.
tip1: Banks never ask for OTP or PIN over links.
tip2: Check the real domain — sbi.co.in, not sbi-kyc-update.xyz.
tip3: Shortened links hide where they go. Expand before trusting.
tip4: Urgency ("account suspended!") is a classic scam trick.
aboutText: PhishGuard AI is a heuristic phishing detector built for India's digital users, analyzing URL structure, brand impersonation and scam keywords.
